body.intent: Build roles get afk's shipit/forge prompts in Rhiza's words, one guide topic each on the six-section skeleton (task, expected outcome, read first, must do, must not do, context) with shared blocks written once: builder, verifier (re-run reported checks and acceptance, findings a fixer can act on) and builder retry; the builtin build prompts shrink to one line. Source: prompt-gap.md sections 2.3, 2.4 and 5 (CS1).
